query: Why is learning satisfaction low for certain groups, and which factors drive it?

per_column.name: satisfaction_category
per_column.rationale: Directly redundant with existing satisfaction_1to5 (a binned restatement), so limited new leverage, but a convenient grouping axis; values align well with numeric satisfaction and tone.

per_column.name: mentions_community_impact
per_column.rationale: Peer-interaction/community theme is a genuine driver axis for the query. However Yes-labels appear loosely applied (ED-0005 participation, ED-0002 unclear) suggesting over-broad tagging.

per_column.name: mentions_hands_on_limitation
per_column.rationale: Relevant potential driver, but clearly mislabeled: ED-0002 and ED-0004 marked Yes without any hands-on limitation, while ED-0001 (no lab) is No. Values not well grounded.

per_column.name: mentions_technical_issues
per_column.rationale: Strong driver axis; ED-0001 (camera freezes) and ED-0003 (logs out) correctly Yes, others No. Well grounded.

per_column.name: mentions_emotional_wellbeing
per_column.rationale: Highly relevant to low satisfaction; ED-0001 ('miss raising hand') and ED-0003 ('cries') plausibly Yes. Mostly grounded, slightly loose on ED-0001.

per_column.name: mentions_teacher_quality
per_column.rationale: Reasonable driver axis, but ED-0002 Yes is unsupported (self-report, no quality claim); other rows plausible. Mixed grounding.

per_column.name: mentions_async_learning
per_column.rationale: Distinctive driver axis (recorded/self-paced); ED-0004 ('pause recorded lectures') and ED-0002 correctly Yes. Well grounded.

judge.rationale: The added columns provide multiple genuine thematic driver axes (technical issues, emotional wellbeing, async learning, community impact) well suited to explaining low satisfaction and grouping by respondent role/grade/subject, giving real analytical leverage beyond the original numeric score. satisfaction_category is somewhat redundant with the existing 1-5 score. Groundedness is solid for technical_issues, emotional_wellbeing, and async_learning, but weaker for mentions_hands_on_limitation (clear mislabels on ED-0002/ED-0004), teacher_quality (ED-0002), and community_impact (over-broad Yes tagging), indicating a tendency to over-assert theme presence. Overall useful set with moderate grounding reliability.
